verdict.rationale: Veo is offered through the Gemini API, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no such spec: probes of all candidate OpenAPI/Swagger paths on ai.google.dev returned 404. The deepmind llms.txt describes prompt formatting, not an API schema, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
